findings.evidence: The active delta requires every platform fast-forward of integration main to append a receipt (openspec/changes/claude-external-advance/specs/model-routing/spec.md:5). In template/scripts/finish_task.py:522–529, main advances before publication, but a publication exception exits before the receipt is written. On retry, advanced_from already equals advanced_to, so the receipt is skipped even after publication succeeds. tests/test_git_lifecycle.py explicitly confirms this behavior in test_publication_failure_then_unchanged_head_retry_succeeds with receipt.assert_not_called(). The resulting missing chain makes Claude recording fail despite a legitimate sibling advance.
findings.summary: A failed direct publication followed by a successful retry permanently omits the required integration-advance receipt, stranding overlapping Claude delegations.
